{"title": "Sankalpa", "summary": "The full sankalpa template — from the samvatsara to the name."}

In the sankalpa the host states the place, the time and his own identity, and then the purpose of the rite. The order is: samvatsara, ayana, ritu, masa, paksha, tithi, vara, nakshatra, gotra, name. The tithi and nakshatra are read from a panchang; this site does not compute them.

| Part | Example |
|---|---|
| Samvatsara | Vishvavasu |
| Masa | Kartik |
| Paksha | Shukla |
